values.binNote: Bin's BaseDamagePerSecond [10/15/20/25/30] and DamageperSecondAPRatio 0.12 are per-second values; wiki's per-tick numbers (every 0.25s, 4 ticks/sec) are exactly these divided by 4 (10/4=2.5, 0.12/4=0.03), confirming the tick rate.
Total = per-tick x20 ticks (5s duration / 0.25s tick = 20 ticks), equal to BaseDamagePerSecond x5s (10x5=50) and DamageperSecondAPRatio x5 (0.12x5=0.6); this is a derived 'total' figure.

mechanics.claim: Enemies within the center of the black hole are executed below a health threshold, dealing lethal damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} below {{as|5%|hp}}

mechanics.claim: Epic monsters are excluded from the execute effect.
Spell Shield blocks a single instance of the damage-over-time.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block a single instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Enemies in the black hole are pulled toward the center and minions/monsters have their movement speed reduced to 0, but this does not change damage dealt or taken directly.
mechanics.quote: Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} inward until they reach the center, and {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} also have their {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' to a {{as|static 0|ms}}

mechanics.claim: The damage area hits targets by edge range while the pull area hits by center range, creating a fringe where damage can apply without displacement.
mechanics.quote: The damage area hits targets by their {{tip|edge range|edge}}, while the {{tip|kinematics}} area hits targets by their {{tip|centered range|center}}.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins only after the ability's full effect (5-second duration) ends, not on cast.
Singularity's execute against an enemy champion aggros nearby enemy minions.
mechanics.quote: ''Singularity's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
